WITH invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        SUM(derived_product_cost) AS product_cost,
        SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_cost,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        product_cost / NULLIF(total_cost, 0) AS product_cost_ratio,
        line_item_count
    FROM invoice_totals
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(product_cost_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
    ir.invoice_number,
    ir.product_cost_ratio,
    ir.line_item_count,
    ir.product_cost_ratio / NULLIF(oa.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM invoice_ratios AS ir
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE oa.average_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
